name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role or class colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: Bar colour: in Appearance → Bars you can now paint each player's bar in their class colour — the same colours the game uses for the class crests — instead of the role colour. Off by default; set per layout (List, Party 5, Party 20).
Value text: choose how the numbers on the bar are drawn — plain, with a thin dark outline, or on a soft shadow — so they stay readable on bright class colours. Plain by default.
changed: Requires Stellar framework 2.8.0 or newer (the launcher updates it for you).
